hero.title: An execution partner for the work that keeps a company moving.
hero.subtitle: We sit inside your sales, marketing, operations, HR and technology work — the way an internal team would — and carry it forward with our own platforms for education, counselling and performance built in.
hero.stat1Label: Functions we execute inside partner companies
hero.stat2Label: Products built and run by Woways
hero.stat3Label: Stages in how we work: execute, grow, transform

capabilitiesIntro: Woways works alongside partnered companies as an added execution layer — taking on the day-to-day work across five functions so internal teams can focus on the decisions only they can make.

capabilities.name: Sales
capabilities.desc: Pipeline execution, outreach and closing support that plugs into your existing targets.

capabilities.name: Marketing
capabilities.desc: Campaigns, content and channel work run end to end, reporting back into your team.

capabilities.name: Operations
capabilities.desc: Process execution and coordination that keeps daily operations moving without gaps.

capabilities.name: HR
capabilities.desc: Hiring, onboarding and people operations handled with your standards, on your timeline.

capabilities.name: Technology
capabilities.desc: Product, platform and tooling work — including the SaaS products we build ourselves.

processIntro: Every engagement moves through the same three stages — it's the reason clients bring us in, and the reason we stay.

process.title: Execute
process.desc: We take on the work that's already defined — running it well, on schedule, inside your existing systems.

process.title: Grow
process.desc: Once the work is stable, we look for where it can scale — more reach, more output, more coverage.

process.title: Transform
process.desc: We bring in the data, tooling and process changes that shift how the function runs going forward.

productsIntro: Alongside execution work, Woways builds and runs its own platforms — for students choosing a path, and for companies running their teams.

talentIgnition.name: Talent Ignition
talentIgnition.lead: An edtech platform that closes the gap between what students are taught and what industry expects — turning passive learners into active ones with a clear career path ahead of them.
features: Identifies where a student's academic gap is holding them back
Builds knowledge and confidence to close that gap directly
Moves students from passive learning to active participation
Provides career counselling aligned to real industry expectations

consulbuzz.name: ConsulBuzz
consulbuzz.lead: A platform for students and their parents to make sense of career and college decisions together — built around what the family actually expects from the outcome.

subproducts.name: Student Mentor
subproducts.desc: Counselling for students after 12th, helping them choose the right career path with clarity instead of guesswork.

subproducts.name: College Macha
subproducts.desc: A way to explore colleges, compare them side by side, and land on the one that fits both the student and the parent's expectations.

bispun.name: Bispun
bispun.lead: A CRM built for entities that need to track their day-to-day work clearly — and act on what the data is telling them, with AI helping surface corrections and plans.
features: Tracks regular work across teams in one place
Surfaces AI-driven corrections and future plans from the data
Works as an entity management portal for the organisation

performanceCrm.name: Performance CRM
performanceCrm.lead: A day-to-day performance tracker for organisations, built so no one misses the appraisal or hike they've earned — and no department loses sight of its own progress.
features: Tracks each employee's KRAs and KPIs continuously, not just at review time
Keeps individuals visible for appraisal and hike decisions
Rolls up into an entity performance portal across every department

contact.title: Let's work out where you need us.
contact.subtitle: Tell us a little about your company and what you're trying to get done. We'll come back with where Woways fits — execution support, one of our products, or both.
contact.point1: One short form. No sales call unless you ask for one.
contact.point2: We reply from a real person on the Woways team, not an inbox.
